lessons.error: object not found for forex tickers
lessons.cause: getSymbols with auto.assign=TRUE creates EURUSD.X not EURUSD
lessons.fix: always use auto.assign=FALSE for ALL getSymbols calls

lessons.cause: trying to access $Close directly instead of using Cl() function
lessons.fix: always use Cl() to extract closing prices, never $Close

lessons.cause: R code getting truncated before completion
lessons.fix: set max_tokens to 4096 and always end script with # END OF SCRIPT

lessons.error: no applicable method for Cl applied to non-xts object
lessons.cause: the object returned by getSymbols with auto.assign=FALSE is already an xts object but sometimes Cl() fails if the data has no volume column like forex
lessons.fix: for forex tickers use this exact pattern: eurusd <- getSymbols('EURUSD=X', src='yahoo', auto.assign=FALSE); eurusd_close <- eurusd[,4] instead of Cl(eurusd)

lessons.error: wrong ticker or variable name for oil
lessons.cause: using CLF or auto.assign=TRUE for oil futures
lessons.fix: always use auto.assign=FALSE and assign oil futures (CL=F) to a variable named crude_oil, e.g. crude_oil <- getSymbols('CL=F', src='yahoo', auto.assign=FALSE). Never use CLF. Unless the user specifically specifies another symbol or name.
